title: Endpoint agents get an inner-model override
summary:
Endpoint agents gained model overrides and richer modality listings, while community model health checks and agent guidance got a tune-up.

Chat completion requests can now set `agent_model` to choose an endpoint agent’s inner model without changing its outer model identity. Omitting it keeps the registered default. Ask Polli also moved to a read-only Claude Code runtime through Gen, with a longer timeout.

Endpoint agents can declare input and output modalities through the existing create and update APIs. Those declarations appear in account listings and model catalogs, including support for multiple output types and 3D; agents without declarations remain text-only.

Monitoring now requires stronger short- and seven-day success rates before unreliable community models appear in listings. Successful fallback responses count toward health, and the seven-day audit covers audio, video, and embedding models. Exact-ID calls remain available for models hidden from listings.

daily.title: Choose an agent’s inner model
daily.text: Set `agent_model` in a chat completion request to choose an endpoint agent’s inner model while keeping its outer model identity. Leave it out to use the agent’s registered default. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Declare agent modalities
daily.text: Endpoint agents can declare the input and output types they support, including multiple output types and 3D. The declarations appear in account listings and model catalogs. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
